cohort: Samples of fetal membranes from 18 patients undergoing cesarean deliveries (n=10) or vaginal deliveries (n=8)
finding: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) can be used to delineate layers and histologic features of human fetal membranes immediately after delivery.
mod_finding: OCT was able to image histologic features of the fetal membranes delivered vaginally, such as microscopic chorionic pseudocysts, ghost villi, meconium stained membranes, and chorioamnionitis.
